attempts.text: [{"name":"i_conv14","idea":"Item conversion rates over the last 14 days of history: share of item sessions with a cart, share with an order, and the share of carting sessions that also ordered (smoothed).","kind":"feature","level":"item","sql":"WITH ci AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM cand), hs AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, max(CASE WHEN x.event = 'cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c, max(CASE WHEN x.event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM hist x JOIN ci ON ci.item = x.item WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 14*86400 GROUP BY x.session, x.item), a AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n, sum(c) AS nc, sum(o) AS nor, sum(c * o) AS nco FROM hs GROUP BY item) SELECT ci.item, (coalesce(a.nc, 0) + 0.1) / (coalesce(a.n, 0) + 10.0) AS ag_i_cart_rate, (coalesce(a.nor, 0) + 0.03) / (coalesce(a.n, 0) + 10.0) AS ag_i_order_rate, (coalesce(a.nco, 0) + 1.0) / (coalesce(a.nc, 0) + 3.0) AS ag_i_c2o FROM ci LEFT JOIN a ON a.item = ci.item;"},{"name":"i_trend","idea":"Item momentum: distinct history sessions in the last day before the week, their ratio to the last 7 days, and target-week prefix sessions relative to the 7-day history.","kind":"feature","level":"item","sql":"WITH ci AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM cand), hh AS (SELECT x.item, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.ts >= {S} - 86400 THEN x.session END) AS d1, count(DISTINCT x.session) AS d7 FROM hist x JOIN ci ON ci.item = x.item WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 7*86400 GROUP BY x.item), w AS (SELECT s.item, count(DISTINCT s.session) AS wk FROM sess s JOIN ci ON ci.item = s.item GROUP BY s.item) SELECT ci.item, CAST(coalesce(hh.d1, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_d1_sess, (coalesce(hh.d1, 0) + 1.0) / (coalesce(hh.d7, 0) + 7.0) AS ag_i_trend1, (coalesce(w.wk, 0) + 1.0) / (coalesce(hh.d7, 0) + 5.0) AS ag_i_wk_ratio FROM ci LEFT JOIN hh ON hh.item = ci.item LEFT JOIN w ON w.item = ci.item;"},{"name":"p_dwell","idea":"Prefix engagement per item: total dwell time on its events (gap to the next prefix event, capped at 600 s), its events among the last 10 prefix events, and its share of prefix events.","kind":"feature","level":"pair","sql":"WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.ts, lead(x.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY x.session ORDER BY x.seq, x.item) AS nt, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.session ORDER BY x.seq DESC, x.item DESC) AS rp, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY x.session) AS n FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), d AS (SELECT session, item, CASE WHEN nt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE least(nt - ts, 600) END AS dt, rp, n FROM s), g AS (SELECT session, item, CAST(sum(dt) AS DOUBLE) AS dw, CAST(sum(CASE WHEN rp <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS l10, count(*) * 1.0 / max(n) AS sh FROM d GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, g.dw AS ag_p_dwell, g.l10 AS ag_p_last10, g.sh AS ag_p_share FROM cand c LEFT JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item;"},{"name":"last_aff","idea":"Affinity of every candidate, including history items, to the prefix: 7-day co-visitation and 14-day next-item count from the last prefix item, and the strongest co-buy count from any of the last 20 prefix items.","kind":"feature","level":"pair","sql":"WITH lp AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, s.seq, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS r FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session), li AS (SELECT session, item FROM lp WHERE r = 1), pi AS (SELECT session, item, max(seq) AS ls FROM lp GROUP BY session, item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), pt AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 20), cv AS (SELECT li.session, c.item2 AS item, c.tv_ns AS v FROM li JOIN tb_covis_any7 c ON c.item = li.item), nx AS (SELECT li.session, n.item2 AS item, n.tv_ns AS v FROM li JOIN tb_next_any14 n ON n.item = li.item), bb AS (SELECT pt.session, b.item2 AS item, max(b.tv_ns) AS v FROM pt JOIN tb_buy2buy b ON b.item = pt.item GROUP BY pt.session, b.item2) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(cv.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_last_covis, CAST(nx.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_last_next, CAST(bb.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_buy_max FROM cand c LEFT JOIN cv ON cv.session = c.session AND cv.item = c.item LEFT JOIN nx ON nx.session = c.session AND nx.item = c.item LEFT JOIN bb ON bb.session = c.session AND bb.item = c.item;"},{"name":"order_aff","idea":"Order intent toward every candidate: strongest any-to-order count from any of the last 20 prefix items and summed view-to-order sessions from the last 5 distinct prefix items.","kind":"feature","level":"pair","sql":"WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), ao AS (SELECT pr.session, o.item2 AS item, max(o.tv_ns) AS v FROM pr JOIN tb_any2order o ON o.item = pr.item WHERE pr.rp <= 20 GROUP BY pr.session, o.item2), vc AS (SELECT pr.session, v.item2 AS item, sum(v.tv_no) AS v FROM pr JOIN tb_view2cart v ON v.item = pr.item WHERE pr.rp <= 5 GROUP BY pr.session, v.item2) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(ao.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_a2o_max, CAST(vc.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_v2o_last5 FROM cand c LEFT JOIN ao ON ao.session = c.session AND ao.item = c.item LEFT JOIN vc ON vc.session = c.session AND vc.item = c.item;"}]
